models.description: MTNN v5 incumbent: 64-d L2-normalized player-season embedding. Concatenated towers (2 blocks, hidden 160, tower out 32), MLP 128, fusion 256. Incumbent since 2026-07-25.
known_limits: Lineage is reconstructed from served bytes, not from the original promote.py run directory (which is absent from the repo).
Export floors were waived by --force (missing test recall / 14-d baseline recall at record time).
Train git SHA, checkpoint hash, and run report are not recoverable from the repo — recorded as null until the original run files are found or a replacement champion is ordered.
mtnn_jacobian.json and mtnn_attr_pop.json are 48-d July 11-14 exports marked not_from_served_net — not from this run.

held_out_adjacent_season_retrieval.protocol: Query the shipped 64-d space with a player's season N; hit if that same player's season N+1 (stable NBA PLAYER_ID) ranks top-k among all 12,966 player-seasons. Splits: train <=2021, val 2022-23, test >=2024.

provenance.force_reason: Adopted the July 2026 v5 incumbent already served on master (git blob a4918f09). The original promote.py run directory is not in this repo; lineage records the served bytes. Not a new promotion.

data_window.filter: every player with 2+ seasons; 514 one-season rows excluded

models.description: MTNN v6 smoke run: 128-d, 3 tower blocks (hidden 256, tower out 64), MLP 256, fusion 512. ~35x the v5 parameter count (~7.8M est torch). Challenger only — not promoted, not exported, not served.
known_limits: Sklearn-fallback training (the report names it), not the full torch pipeline.
No held-out win over the v5 champion, so it stays a challenger under the standing rule: no promotion without a held-out win and Cameron's word.

metrics.note: Training loss only. No held-out retrieval evaluation comparable to the v5 champion's eval_scoreboard protocol has been run; it has not cleared any promotion gate.

open_decisions: Single-model serving policy vs multi-model platform — Cameron's call (Pillar 1.8).
Served-model lineage gate resolution: find the original July v5 run files, or order a deliberate replacement champion — Cameron's call (see models/lineage-gate.md).
schema_note: Versioned model registry for Vector Hoops. Every served model gets: id, vintage, data window, metrics, status, artifact paths, provenance. Seeded from repo-verified facts only; fields not verifiable in the repo are null or "unknown" — never invented.
serving_policy_note: Changed only on Cameron's word (Pillar 1.8 open decision). The site serves one promoted, exported MTNN bundle, verified by scripts/check_served_model.py in CI.
